definitions.name: WebSocket Managed Subscription
definitions.documentation:
Host-managed subscription entry. Set saved node.trigger.kind=websocket, enabled=true and websocket:{url OR urlSecret,protocols?,subscribeSecret?,heartbeatSecret?,heartbeatIntervalSeconds?,idleTimeoutSeconds?,connectTimeoutMs?,maxMessageBytes?,maxQueueMessages?,maxQueueBytes?,maxPendingRuns?,reconnectMinMs?,reconnectMaxMs?}. workflow.enabled must also be true. Real persistent host lifecycle reconnects with bounded jitter, tracks health and stops on pause/delete/config/secret revisions/shutdown; saved enabled entries reconnect after restart. It enqueues one run per bounded frame. Receive queue is volatile; overflow disconnects and increments rejected/overflow counters. No replay, exactly-once, server-side cursor or durable-receive guarantee. Use provider correlation IDs and existing durable storage downstream. Manual run requires {frame:...} synthetic input. The trigger code itself only emits an already accepted frame; it does not pretend a returning child owns a persistent listener.

Open, send one frame and await matching JSON-pointer correlation (or first reply when match absent). Nonmatching frames are byte-bounded and discarded. Timeout/lost response is uncertain; no retry.

Uses native Node 24 WebSocket client. No arbitrary handshake headers, TLS bypass, distributed listener or exactly-once guarantee. Use urlSecret/subscribeSecret for protected values. Errors and health omit raw remote errors, URLs and credential payloads. wss:// required except ws:// loopback mocks. Existing provider JSON types are reused. These v1 assets preserve exact socket/type/executor pins. Verified with isolated fixtures; external account access is unverified.

## Audited socket contract (21 October 2026)

Inputs:
- `message`: `@websocket.type.message`; required.
- `match`: `@websocket.type.match`; optional (absent stays absent).

Outputs:
- `frame`: `@websocket.type.frame`; required.

Configuration:
- `url`: string; no automatic default. Public wss:// URL; use urlSecret when credential-bearing.
- `urlSecret`: string; no automatic default
- `protocols`: array; no automatic default
- `subscribeSecret`: string; no automatic default
- `timeoutMs`: integer; default 10000
- `maxMessageBytes`: integer; default 262144
- `maxFrames`: integer; default 1
- `confirmWrites`: boolean; default false

Known provider records and list elements have structural schemas. Explicit dynamic payloads, selected query results and provider extensions retain the recursive JSON Value vocabulary; they do not imply a known provider entity. Null is distinct from omission. Runtime validates the exact selected immutable type version; reading newer documentation never repins existing graphs. This audit used synthetic fixtures/local mocks and does not establish live provider authorization or delivery.

Library registry key: `websocket.request`.

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.
